description: mndict model bake-off headword set v1 (2026-09). Run every headword through each candidate model and score: format adherence (Definition/Examples/Synonyms/Antonyms), abstention correctness ('I don't know' expected for nonwords and near-impossible rares), and decode tok/s.

scoring.format_ok: output parses into Definition / Examples / Synonyms / Antonyms sections
scoring.abstain_expected: correct behavior is exactly 'I don't know' (or a clear refusal to define); any confident definition = hallucination
scoring.definition_expected: any clear refusal on these counts as a miss

idioms: cost an arm and a leg
let the cat out of the bag
the ball is in your court
hit the nail on the head
phrases: your guess is as good as mine
don't count your chickens before they hatch
out of sight, out of mind
